description: This file implements the Damerau-Levenshtein distance algorithm to compute the minimum number of operations needed to transform one string into another, considering swaps, substitutions, deletions, and insertions. It defines a single function `levenshtein` which calculates this distance with weighted costs for different operations.

methods.description: Calculates the Damerau-Levenshtein distance between two strings with weighted costs for swaps, substitutions, insertions, and deletions.
